perfil: Journalist, researcher and product and strategic-operations professional with more than 10 years of experience in journalism, research, digital innovation and strategic communication. Trained in anthropology, sociology, communication, culture and technology. Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, designing digital products, conducting qualitative research, building sustainability strategies for news organizations, and coordinating projects where technology, culture, journalism and social innovation meet.

puntos: Coordinates a regional initiative to preserve the archives of Central American independent media and make them securely accessible for research, historical memory and journalistic work.
Built partnerships with news organizations, universities and digital preservation specialists.
Exceeded an initial target of 13 partner organizations, bringing around 20 outlets into the project.
Coordinates digitization, storage, research and newsroom liaison.
The project grew, in part, out of preserving four terabytes of elPeriódico's historical archive.
Co-founded a consultancy focused on qualitative research, strategic communication, innovation, experience design and organizational strategy.
Has worked with organizations including IDB Invest, BAM, Radio Selva and Prensa Comunitaria.
Designs research, workshops, sprints, sustainability models, audience strategies and organizational transformation processes.
Has advised projects on leadership, organizational culture, psychological safety, organizational structure and performance.
Has supported independent media in redesigning sustainability models, developing products and mapping audience and funding opportunities.
Designed and coordinated digital literacy, STEAM and participation activities for Indigenous girls and young women.
Ran workshops in Sololá and activities tied to Makerfaire and hands-on learning.
Built a community of practice through a website and a WhatsApp channel for teachers and students.
Has supported data collection and analysis to inform public policy on economic development, technology adoption and innovation.
Has worked alongside government actors and development organizations.
Has taught global citizenship, sociology of communication, communication and technology, digital methods, visual anthropology, qualitative methods and strategic communication.
Designs curricula that combine digital tools with qualitative and quantitative methodologies.
Has taught at both undergraduate and graduate level.
Coordinated projects in social innovation, applied research, civic participation and digital methodologies.
Contributed to the redesign of the anthropology curriculum.
Facilitated collaborative processes on civic technology, public discourse, access to rights and citizen participation.
Led the newspaper's digital transformation and the development of new editorial and commercial products.
Launched the digital subscription model, newsletters and mobile apps.
Coordinated newsroom, IT, sales, finance, marketing and subscription teams.
Led the development of digital products for advertisers.
Drove analytics, search, automation and digital tooling to improve the experience of both readers and journalists.
A professional record reports sustained growth of close to 10% month over month in subscriptions during one stage of the project.
Coordinated five team leads and set up cross-departmental working groups to launch new services and products.
